scope: Independent structural QA of kodashim screenshot observation snapshots
method: Independently resolves all current source IDs and hashes, validates exact local image bytes/Drive IDs, deduplicates positions, and preserves raw tag disagreement. Does not validate linguistic accuracy or infer missing morphology. Concurrent in-progress snapshots are explicit.
notes: No source text, pointing, lexical cards or candidate morphology changed.
Unique bound positions include grouped or review-needed readings; this is observation availability, not verified morphology.
Raw tag disagreements may be transcription errors, source ambiguity, different printed groups or harmless tag order; they require original-image review.
